dialogues.speaker: Pursina's Essays: 26
dialogues.text: (True knowledge is not something that can be drawn casually from the Akasha. Instead, the desert-dwellers get a more comprehensive education during their long walks across the sands...)

dialogues.speaker: Pursina's Essays: 26
dialogues.text: (You notice that the bottom of the title page has an emblem belonging to the Akademiya Library... Perhaps this book is among those that have been smuggled.)
